title: Middleware and Extensions
description: Use Prisma Client middleware and extensions to add cross-cutting concerns like logging and caching.

data.text: Prisma Client middleware lets you intercept and modify queries before they are executed. Extensions are the newer, more powerful mechanism for adding cross-cutting concerns.
Middleware wraps Prisma Client methods. It runs for every query and can modify parameters, log queries, or implement caching.

data.title: Logging Middleware
data.content: Add a middleware that logs every query.

items: **Extensions** — Recommended; more granular, type-safe, and composable

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use extensions for new code. They provide better TypeScript support and allow you to compose multiple extensions cleanly.
